opportunity: gzip -O2 gzip_base_name (0xd290) is `endbr64; jmp last_component`: it forwards its own rdi and returns the callee's rax, and kuna renders `void sub_d290(void) { sub_dfd0(); }` while recovering the callee as `char *sub_dfd0(char *a0)` in the same run. DWARF says `char *gzip_base_name(char const *fname)`. A call's argument trials come from Heritage::guardCalls, one per HERITAGED range, and a register the function only forwards is heritaged nowhere, so the call gets no trial and the function no parameter. df dir_name 0x7550 and tar *_diag are the same shape. The O2 census counts 25 register-forward arity-short functions.
inspiration: gzip -O2 gzip_base_name 0xd290, df -O2 dir_name 0x7550, tar -O2 *_diag (decbench full_run_address_2026-09-11); the locked branch of ActionFuncLink::funcLinkInput (coreaction.cc:1500) materializes a declared parameter's read at the call, which is the seam this reuses for a recovered one; AncestorRealistic::execute (funcdata_varnode.cc:2159) refuses an input Varnode at a call slot

rule_change.adds_argument: a register R at a direct, unlocked, non-variadic call is an argument when the callee's recovered prototype (protoorder) has a parameter starting at R and the list is an arity claim (RecoveredTypes::arity_sound: all in registers, body does not read the next arg register, does not saturate the register file, canonical storage), the callee's body proves_input(R), the caller did not set the call up as variadic and is not variadic itself, and the value at the call is the function's own input Varnode. Width is the narrowest of the trial, the parameter and the callee's low-justified body read.
rule_change.adds_return: when every live RETURN is reached from a direct call with nothing between (<=4 single-pred blocks), every such callee states a non-void return in the same register, the function's output is not locked and no op touches that register, the RETURN reads it and the tail call's result is the function's return value, typed by the callee's recovered return. A callee states a return only where its own body computed one: every live RETURN must hand back a value produced in every byte and on every path (kuna_returnuncomputed::every_return_computes), which is the strict form of the question the uncomputed-half pair repair asks.
rule_change.mechanism: claim_untouched_registers (end of ActionFuncLink) registers a trial + a CALL read for an untouched register only at a call no other CALL/CALLIND can precede (first_calls); heritage registers the range at every other call as usual and only guardReturns is kept off it (suppresses_return_trial); check_input_trial_use never scores a trial on a claimed range (claimed_range -> inactive, never no-use); capture (first in build_input_from_trials) keeps unused trials standing on the function's own input with the evidence and retires unused claimed-range trials; extend_pending (last in ActionActiveParam, after calleearityfwd/calleearitylive/calleearitybody) appends the stated registers that follow a final list that is a leading run of the stated one; returns_tail_result scores the RETURN trial; tail_return_type feeds call_output_type_local.
